scope: Actual Java executables running sbt.ForkMain in the frozen landing checkout; shell command text and plain readers excluded.
limitations: Only actual Java sbt.ForkMain launches are recorded; this path-level scope includes the standalone API-audit-tool sub-build, whose own build does not install root common/laws fork settings.
The artifact consumer is a separate build. Empty IPv6 options in those separate builds are not interpreted as missing root common/laws settings.
Default-setting attribution also uses the frozen launcher environment and uninterrupted full gate; no property is inferred from parent JUnit XML.
